title: DX Initiative: Signal Heatmap → OKR Mapping & Quarterly Rollup
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable mapping and rollup process that converts DX signals (SDK adoption, quickstart completion, docs friction, retention cohorts) into an initiative heatmap and then ties that heatmap to objective-level OKRs for the quarter. This ticket scopes the strategy, tooling changes, and dashboard artifacts needed for a first pilot across SDK and Docs initiatives.
objectives: Define a signal taxonomy and weighted heatmap algorithm for DX initiatives
Produce a one-click rollup from heatmap to OKR progress that PMs and leadership can consume
Pilot the mapping on 6 active SDK/docs initiatives and surface change recommendations for Q2 planning
success_metrics: Heatmap -> OKR rollup available in Console: 1-click export (CSV + dashboard)
>75% alignment between heatmap-prioritized items and PM sprint commitments in pilot cohorts
Reduce manual OKR status updates for DX initiatives by 60% in the pilot
milestones: 2025-02-20: Signal taxonomy proposal delivered and reviewed
2025-03-05: Heatmap weighting prototype and sample dataset produced
2025-03-18: Dashboard mockups and export schema approved
2025-03-25: Pilot rollout to 6 initiatives and collection of feedback
2025-04-01: Pilot retro and recommendations for org-wide adoption
notes: 2025-02-14 — Kickoff: aligned on scope; agreed to prioritize SDK adoption and docs completion rate as primary signals. Action: Analytics to deliver sample dataset by 2/20.
2025-02-21 — Signal taxonomy review: added 'first-success time' and 'example-app run rate' as candidate signals after Design input; proposed weights documented in GDrive (link below).
2025-03-03 — Prototype demo: heatmap algorithm running on last 3 months of activity; early results surfaced an unexpected docs friction cluster for Python SDK quickstarts.
2025-03-05 — Decision: pilot on 6 initiatives (4 SDKs, 2 docs/quickstarts). Dashboard iteration to include drilldown to PRs and relative contribution per signal.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Signals may be noisy and produce misleading priorities - Mitigation: require manual PM review and confidence score on rollup
Risk: Analytics sampling bias (new org members inflate adoption) - Mitigation: normalize signals by cohort start date and control for traffic spikes
Risk: Dashboard performance for large datasets - Mitigation: pre-aggregate weekly buckets and cache heatmap tiles
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap prototype runs end-to-end on historical data with documented weights
Exportable rollup mapping that translates heatmap cells into OKR progress metrics (CSV + dashboard widget)
Pilot completed on 6 initiatives with retro notes and recommended changes for Q2 planning
Handoff doc and short training (30m) for PMs explaining how to interpret the heatmap → OKR mapping
